minecraft:experience_bottle: A bottle that bursts into experience orbs when thrown. It can't be crafted; clerics sell it, and it appears in some chests. It is handy for repairing gear with Mending.
minecraft:fire_charge: A fireball made from blaze powder, coal and gunpowder. Use it to light fires like flint and steel, or fire it from a dispenser. Each use consumes one charge.
minecraft:wind_charge: A burst of wind dropped by breezes. Throw it to knock back mobs, or throw it at your feet to launch yourself into the air. It also flips levers, buttons and doors it hits.
minecraft:writable_book: A book you can write in, made from a book, an ink sac and a feather. Write up to a hundred pages. Sign it to turn it into a finished written book.
minecraft:written_book: A signed book with a title and author that can no longer be edited. Copy it by crafting it with a book and quill. Place it on a lectern so others can read it.
minecraft:mace: A heavy weapon made from a heavy core and a breeze rod. Its smash attack hits harder the farther you fall before striking. Wind charges and the Wind Burst enchantment let you chain smashes.
minecraft:item_frame: A frame for displaying items on walls, made from eight sticks and leather. Right-click to put an item in and rotate it. Framed maps show their markers.
minecraft:glow_item_frame: An item frame that makes its item glow even in the dark. Craft an item frame with a glow ink sac. It works just like a normal frame otherwise.
minecraft:flower_pot: A small pot made from three bricks. Place flowers, saplings, mushrooms, cacti and more inside it. It keeps plants neat on shelves and windowsills.
minecraft:carrot: A crunchy vegetable found in villages and sometimes dropped by zombies. Plant it on farmland to grow more. Pigs and rabbits love it, and it makes golden carrots.
minecraft:potato: A vegetable grown on farmland, found in villages and sometimes dropped by zombies. Eat it raw or bake it for much more food. Plant it to grow more.
minecraft:baked_potato: A potato baked in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is cheap and quite filling. Farmers can grow lots of them easily.
minecraft:poisonous_potato: A green potato that rarely appears when harvesting potatoes. Eating it may poison you. Compost it instead.
minecraft:map: A blank map made from eight paper around a compass. Use it to create a map of the area around you. Cartographers sell maps to special structures.
minecraft:golden_carrot: A carrot wrapped in eight gold nuggets. It is one of the best foods for saturation. It brews potions of night vision and can be fed to horses.
minecraft:skeleton_skull: A skull dropped by skeletons killed by a charged creeper's explosion. Wear it, place it as decoration, or put it on a note block to play skeleton sounds. Wearing it makes skeletons notice you less.
minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull: A rare skull dropped by wither skeletons. Three on top of four soul sand or soul soil in a T shape summon the Wither. It can also be worn or placed.
minecraft:player_head: A head showing a player's skin. It can only be obtained with commands. It makes a fun decoration.
minecraft:zombie_head: A head dropped by zombies killed by a charged creeper. Wear it, or place it as decoration. Wearing it makes zombies notice you less.
minecraft:creeper_head: A head dropped by creepers killed by a charged creeper. Wear it to make creepers notice you less. On a banner it adds a creeper face pattern.
minecraft:dragon_head: A head found on the bows of End ships. Powered by redstone, its mouth opens and closes. Wear it or place it as a striking decoration.
minecraft:piglin_head: A head dropped by piglins killed by a charged creeper. Its ears flap when powered by redstone. Wearing it makes piglins notice you less.
minecraft:nether_star: A star dropped by the Wither when defeated. It is needed to craft a beacon. It can't be destroyed by explosions.
minecraft:pumpkin_pie: A pie baked from a pumpkin, sugar and an egg. It restores plenty of hunger. It is a good way to use spare pumpkins.
minecraft:firework_rocket: A rocket made from paper and gunpowder, with optional firework stars. Launch it for a show, or use it while gliding with elytra to fly faster. Crossbows can fire them too.
minecraft:firework_star: A star made from gunpowder and dye that sets the colors and shape of a firework. Add extras like glowstone dust for twinkle or a diamond for a trail. Craft it into a firework rocket.
minecraft:enchanted_book: A book holding an enchantment. Combine it with an item on an anvil to apply its enchantment. Get it from enchanting books, trading with librarians or looting chests.
minecraft:nether_brick: A small dark brick made by smelting netherrack. Four craft into a nether brick block. It is also needed for nether brick fences.
minecraft:prismarine_shard: A shard dropped by guardians and elder guardians. It crafts into prismarine, prismarine bricks and dark prismarine. It is part of the sea lantern and conduit recipes.
minecraft:prismarine_crystals: Glowing crystals dropped by guardians and sea lanterns. Together with prismarine shards they craft sea lanterns. They can't be made any other way.
